Name: Zechariah, Prince of Judah
Summary: Zechariah was one of the princes Jehoshaphat sent in his third year to teach in the cities of Judah, distinct from the other Zechariahs of the book.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat sent his princes, including Zechariah, to teach in the cities of Judah.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
